class Node:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data = data
        self.left = None
        self.right = None
        self.random = None

def cloneTree(root):
    if root is None:
        return None
    new_root = Node(root.data)
    new_root.left = cloneTree(root.left)
    new_root.right = cloneTree(root.right)
    new_root.random = cloneTree(root.random)
    return new_root
